# §27 — Corrected system-flow detail sheets
**CHD-3.4 · SPEC V3.4. REVISION NOTICE — supersedes CHD-3.3 figures listed here.**
Sections 1, 5, 9, 10, 13, 14 and 21 refer to these full-size detail drawings. Legacy figure geometry is not reused for changed semantics.

## Detail FIGURE 1.3-1: CONTROL AUTHORITY
![FIGURE 1.3-1](../figures/fig-1.3-1.svg)
FIGURE 1.3-1 — CONTROL AUTHORITY. Snapshot: 2026-11-11.
The scheduler and Crier never write control authority. Report verification and runtime stop proof are separate paths.
1. Follow the labelled producer-to-consumer edge; each row denotes its own effect, not an implied transition between rows. 2. Read the owning section for exact identity, guard, ordered writes and failure state. 3. Refuse the side effect when the named capability, correlation or durable readback is absent. 4. An OPEN adapter boundary remains a release gate, not a dotted implementation promise.
